title: Predictive Dialler Rules: Ofcom Has No 3% Safe Harbour
meta_description: Ofcom’s policy names no safe abandoned call rate. It weighs silent calls, messages within 2 seconds, repeats inside 72 hours, CLI and 6 months of records.

image.takeaway: Ofcom’s policy since 1 March 2017 names no safe abandoned call rate and puts silent calls first.
image.alt: Hero card for an article on UK predictive dialler rules: Ofcom’s persistent misuse policy, in force since 1 March 2017, names no safe abandoned call rate and says silent calls are likely to be its highest priority.

chart.title: Ofcom’s worked example: 1,000 calls in one day
chart.subtitle: How Ofcom splits a day of dialling before it computes the abandoned call rate.
chart.source: Basis: Ofcom persistent misuse statement, Annex 3 example. Source: ofcom.org.uk, November 2026.
chart.alt: Bar chart of Ofcom’s worked example of one day of dialling: of 1,000 calls, 400 were passed to agents but were answer machines, 392 were live calls, 200 never connected and 8 were abandoned. Ofcom estimates 3.96 of the 8 abandoned calls reached people, giving an abandoned call rate of 1.00%.
